title: DreamSkip
description: DreamSkip automatically skips the night as soon as the required number of players go to bed.
body:
# ✨ What is DreamSkip?

**DreamSkip** automatically skips the night as soon as the required number of players go to bed.
It’s a true slice-of-life feature that makes multiplayer survival much more comfortable.

# 🎮 Features

- ✅ Instantly turns night into day once the required number of players are sleeping
- ✅ Bossbar message to all players: “required players (x/x)” with a progress bar and color scale
- ✅ Configurable required player amount
- ✅Full plugin features can be toggled per world
- ✅ Persistent JSON-based storage for all settings


# 🛠 Commands & permissions

1. /sleep on <world> – Enables the plugin features in a world (Permission: sleep.use)
2. /sleep off <world> – Disables the plugin features in a world (Permission: sleep.use)
3. /sleep playeramount <number> <world> – Changes the required number of players to skip the night (Permission: sleep.use)
4. /sleep list – Shows all configured worlds (Permission: sleep.use)
5. /sleep reload – Reloads the configuration (Permission: sleep.use)
6. /sleep help – Displays the help menu (Permission: sleep.use)

# ⚙️ Configuration & storage
## Java (persistent – permanently stored)
All settings are saved in plugins/DreamSkip/dreamskip_worldconfig.json.
The file is automatically loaded on server startup and saved when changes are made or the server stops.
Format (JSON structure):
{
  "world_name": {
    "plugin_online": true / false
    “Playeramount”: int
  },
[...]
}

# 📸 Showcase 
![Configured DreamSkip](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b7f33d1d63a5265bcd1306a5a39bc15cc3fe0def_0.webp)

# 📂 Installation
1. Download **DreamSkip-<pluginversion>-<minecraftversion>.jar**.
2. Place it in your server's plugins folder.
3. Restart the server.
